svg.title: STEP 1 extension: mean weight change on treatment and one year after stopping
svg.desc: Extension subset (327 participants). Semaglutide arm: mean change -17.3% at week 68, then -5.6% net at week 120, one year after semaglutide and the lifestyle program stopped. Placebo arm: -2.0% at week 68 and -0.1% at week 120. Only three time points are plotted.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: After stopping: mean weight change from baseline
